title: SugarFocus — SugarCraft
description: Focus-ring state machine — an ordered set of focusable regions with a single focused member and wrap-around Tab/Shift-Tab traversal for full-window TUI layouts. Dependency-free.
ogDescription: Focus-ring state machine for full-window TUIs: register each focusable region, map Tab to next() and Shift-Tab to previous(), and accent-border the region current() returns only where isEnabled() agrees. Immutable, dependency-free.
tagline: Focus-ring state machine — ordered focusable regions with Tab/Shift-Tab traversal, accent paint gated on isEnabled()
detailMeta: original — no 1:1 Go counterpart focus keyboard navigation
